title: Skillfully plugin messages, contract 1
description: Every message that may cross between the hub and a plugin. Each is one JSON object with a type.

key.description: The name of one value: a capability, then the value's name within it, for example console/input/3/bus/5/level. Names come from the capability's definition, never from a vendor.

hello.description: Plugin to hub. Always the first message.

token.description: The one-time token the hub gave this process at start.

state.description: Plugin to hub. What the device says is true. full means every value the plugin knows; otherwise only what changed.

event.description: Plugin to hub. Something happened that is not a value, such as the device connecting.

result.description: Plugin to hub. The answer to one command. Every value the command set appears exactly once: in values with what the device read back, or in errors.

health.description: Plugin to hub. Sent after the welcome, on every change, and at least every 5 seconds.

settings.description: Plugin to hub. The settings this driver takes, for a driver that can only say so once it is running. The hub shows them to a superuser as a form. They are data for a person to read, never instructions.

kind.description: text, number, toggle and choice are things to fill in. secret is text that is never shown again. note is words to read, with nothing to fill in.

keep.description: Plugin to hub. Something the driver needs again the next time it starts and can only learn while running: what a device handed it when they were paired, for example. The hub keeps the newest one for this device, hands it back in welcome, and does nothing else with it: it is not shown, not logged and not written to any file a person edits. At most 64,000 characters as JSON.

filled.description: Plugin to hub. The driver has filled in some of its own settings: an address it found, or that it is now paired. Only settings in its form that a person could fill in, never a secret, and never one that decides what the driver may reach on the network. The hub keeps them as if a person had typed them, shows them in the form, and does not start the driver again.

welcome.description: Hub to plugin. The answer to hello. Carries the plugin's settings and whatever it last asked the hub to keep, because a plugin stores nothing itself.

command.description: Hub to plugin. Set these values. A command always names the value wanted, never a change to it, so sending it twice is harmless.

resync.description: Hub to plugin. Send a full state now.

mode.description: Hub to plugin. For information only. The hub enforces the mode itself: in listen it never sends a command.

shutdown.description: Hub to plugin. Stop within 2 seconds.
